name: INTERFILM International Short Film Festival Berlin
description: The 42nd edition of INTERFILM, the oldest and largest short film festival in Berlin, celebrates four decades of championing international filmmakers. This Academy Award-qualifying festival showcases short films across all genres—narrative, documentary, animation, and experimental—with a charisma that attracts filmmakers and film fans alike. Founded in 1982 in the squats of Kreuzberg, INTERFILM has become renowned beyond German and European borders.
